113.news_title: Tempest Upright is Premiering at the Australsian Gaming Expo in Sydney 2023
113.long_description: We will be premiering our Tempest Upright arcade machine at the upcoming Australasian Gaming Expo to be held in Sydney at the ICC from 15-17 August 2023. The Tempest arcade machine series is a versatile product highly suitable for street operators and amusement centres who are looking for coin operate solutions. If you are looking for free play options, the Tempest is also great to entertain your guests in waiting rooms, youth centres and for home operations. Tempest arcade machines can be easily upgraded, add your game wizard panel/kit for XBOX/Playstation/PC game play, add a 2nd monitor for advertising the game titles or information to your customers, and much more. We will show both our sitdown and upright Tempest arcade models. Look forward to seeing you on booth #820.
113.short_description: Please visit us on booth #820 to view the first world public release of our Tempest upright arcade machine. The Australasian Gaming Expo will be held in Sydney at the ICC from 15-17 August 2023.
